title: Count Subarrays with Sum K
statement:
Given an array of integers and a target K, count the total number of contiguous subarrays whose sum equals exactly K.

Use the prefix-sum + hash map approach for O(N) time.
inputFormat:
The first line contains N and K.
The second line contains N space-separated integers.
outputFormat: A single integer: the count of subarrays with sum equal to K.

examples.explanation: Subarrays [1,1] at indices (0,1) and (1,2) both sum to 2.
